[ASSISTANT_SAID] If no candidate receives a majority of votes, voting continues until a candidate receives the required majority.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The purpose of caucus meetings is to discuss pending legislation, propose strategies for advancing the party's agenda, and coordinate votes.
